name: 1997 Tournament of Bruises

date.source: The tournament update's own schedule: opening night 1 October 1997, with bracket nights running through 8 October.

venue: the GWA Arena (AOL keyword GWA, live chat room)
notes: An annual single-elimination tournament seeding 32 of the league's own top-ranked wrestlers into four brackets named for its own USA, SWA, CWA and AWA divisions, opening with a Wednesday parade and running bracket nights 1, 4, 5 and 8 October 1997; its winner is promised a GWA World Championship shot within seven days. No bracket assignment or individual bout is named in the surviving announcement, so no wrestler is registered to this show by name; it is held results-free rather than silently thinned.

name: Halloween in Hollywood

date.source: The card's own advance advertisement, dated 26 October 1997, billing the event live 29-30 October at 7pm ET.

venue: the GWA Arena (AOL keyword GWA, live chat room)

matches.stipulation: No-disqualification ladder match for a steel briefcase (the winner may reveal or conceal its contents)
rooftop match, billed as a grudge between two Canadian rivals
straitjacket match, billed as the GWA's Most Popular Wrestler against his most angry fan

notes: A two-night card advertised as roughly 3-4 hours of live roleplay action each night. Beyond the three structured bouts above, the announcement also bills a title-for-title tag match (the reigning World Tag Team Champions, the Power Force, against a challenging team named only Raging Heat, for the USA Tag Team title), the still-unnamed Final Four of the Tournament of Bruises, and a three-team Thunderdome WarGames pitting American Power against the Ring Syndicate against a partly-unnamed 'Tony Pride's Mystery Team' -- none of which this collection registers as a match, since at least one side of each is not named in full; the named participants of the WarGames and tag matchup are registered instead as billed appearances.
